content:
Evidence from the technical table: one QSFP28 **100GBASE-LR4 / eLR4** module with **four simultaneous 25.78 Gbps lanes**, each with its own transmit wavelength range and shared per-lane optical limits. Nominal centers **1295.56 / 1300.05 / 1304.58 / 1309.14** pair with the four min/max ranges on the same rows. Per-lane **average** TX is **−4.3 to +4.5 dBm**, **OMA** sensitivity **−12.5 dBm**, FEC **RS(528,514)** (IEEE 802.3bj). **103.12 Gbps**, **+10.5 dBm total**, **−1.3 dBm OMA TX min**, **−14.5 dBm** min input, **eLR4**, and rounded centers **1296 / 1300 / 1305 / 1309** are the same product row, not separate selectable modes—so they are not split into extra modes without a distinct row/section.
